attributes.content:
**EL-RSP-1.4.2 Rear lamp reaction 10 to 20 ms**

DEVS2_Lighting shall change the rear turn lamps no earlier than 10 ms and no later than 20 ms after receiving a DEVMLIN01Fr01 frame that changes ReqLeft or ReqRight.

description: Obligation of DEVS2_Lighting as DEVS2 in RearLight (EL-RSP-1.4.2).
Supplier commitment. Status accepted: there is no measurement in this repository; the analysis uses the committed window as an input.
